description: Bridges near a point, nearest first. Pass lat/lon in decimal degrees; radius_km defaults to 10 (max 500). Each returned bridge carries distance_km. Bridges with no coordinates are excluded. Unlike the state-scoped tools, this one takes no state, the point is the scope. Read-only; no API key. limit defaults to 100 (max 1000).

radius_km.description: Search radius in km, greater than 0 and at most 500

name: find_bridges_nearby
